instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide eye-level shot. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white columns, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right. The man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing her and kicking his right leg forward so his foot touches her thigh. R1 balances on his left leg during the kick. Overhead studio lights cast soft shadows on the red floor.
elements: R1 kicks his right leg forward so that his foot touches R2's thigh
R2 receives the foot contact on her thigh from R1
R1 balances on his left leg while delivering the kick toward R2
R1 and R2 face each other during the contact
